decisions.reason: The submarine line has had several models developed and naval procurement cycles are long, so sunk investment and the chance that weak results are temporary keep it alive, even though it sits far from the core and was only lightly committed in public.
The medical examination light has its own page, builds on the established offer and fits the LED efficiency direction, so its visible commitment and development cost favor persisting.
The certified explosion-proof industrial line is central to the firm's industrial focus and carries heavy certification investment, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The firm publicly relaunched this designer task light as a popular product close to its core, which commits management to keeping it despite design-product life cycles.
The pendant office luminaire is recent, close to the core and presented on its own page, so any weak results are readily attributed to the pandemic slowdown in office construction.
The premium pendant line has several models and its own page and fits the firm's announced LED direction, so its investment and visibility favor continuation.
